checks.ref: command:if grep -rn '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' openspec/changes --include=tasks.md --exclude-dir=archive; then echo "the tasks listed above are still open - do them, then tick them in tasks.md"; exit 1; fi

command:base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/ and the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no new dependency - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

findings.message: Missing @NFR-P1 tag on the day-track budget scenarios. design.md D4: each budget scenario "adds `@replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks @FR<n> @NFR-P1` on one tag line" (the proposal's Behavior section says the same). packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/time_selection_day_track.feature:60 is `@add-time-sliders-to-location-cards @NFR-P2 @replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks @FR3` and :68 ('The new day's tracks are computed once') is `@replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks @FR3`: neither has @NFR-P1. The matching `// @...` comments in steps/time_selection_day_track.steps.tsx:152-153 and :187 also lack it.

The per-zone transition bound is checked only as a total. The time-selection spec delta says a date change "MUST look up at most 2 time zone transitions per zone", and the scenario says "at most 2 time zone transitions are looked up per zone". time_selection_day_track.steps.tsx:170-178 asserts `transitionLookups() <= maxLookups * TRACK_BUDGET_ROW_COUNT`. The 50 rows are 50 distinct zones (trackBudgetWorld.ts:66-68), so one zone doing more than 2 lookups passes while others do fewer. src/test/workCounters.ts counts formatters per zone (formattersByZone) but not transition lookups. Count lookups per zone (from the ZonedDateTime's timeZoneId in the getTimeZoneTransition spy) and assert each is <= MAX_TRANSITION_LOOKUPS_PER_ZONE.

A feature step drops text from the spec delta. specs/time-selection/spec.md, scenario 'Hour labels are unchanged by formatter reuse': "THEN each track shows the same hour labels as the platform's own date formatting gives for that zone, with the hour label's format, in the same language, without the shared formatters". time_selection_day_track.feature:78 (and the step text in the steps file) stops at "...for that zone". Task 3 says: "first change the feature file to the spec delta's steps".

The bench script differs from tasks.md 6.1 and design.md D5, which both give `"bench": "vitest bench --run --outputJson reports/bench/bench.json"`. packages/client/package.json:14 is `"vitest bench --run --mode test --outputJson reports/bench/bench.json"`. Either use the specified command, or update tasks.md 6.1 and design D5 to the flag that was actually needed.
